text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Bamboo Memory and I are
about to
start our usual training, when...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! Make it extra intense for me
today, will
you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait. What are all those people
doing at the
track?

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
What a great run! I got some great shots
of your
face!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there are a few things I'm not
quite
satisfied with. If possible, I'd like
to run one more
lap!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that should be fine. Let's touch up
your
makeup first.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's an interview! Yaeno has been
getting so
much attention lately.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I run with her all the time, and it always
gets me
so pumped! She's the best!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder people want to interview
her!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You said it! Let's do it!
choice_data_list: We can't afford to fall behind!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Although... Yaeno doesn't seem as sharp
or fired
up as usual...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's like she isn't herself.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Maybe...
choice_data_list: Maybe your mindset's different between the real race and a shoot.
Maybe your mindset's different between the real race and a shoot.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If so, I've got a good idea! I'll be right
back!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: I think this shot came out pretty well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, it's still a touch off. I'm sorry, can we
try it
one more time?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Where's your passion, Yaeno?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo?! Wh-why are you dressed like
that?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, because my signature racewear is
packed
with dreams! I figured it would
get you fired up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to clash with my rivals in
fiery
competition. My trainer and I
designed my
signature racewear with
that vision in mind.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Take a look! The character for "dream" is
literally
sewn into it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Dreams, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right! My signature racewear is my
ticket to
my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now, I want you to take the stage with
me! I'll get
you fired up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh! ...You're right. Bamboo, please run
with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them take off into a

passionate run...

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible! I could see fire in
both of
your eyes as you strove for
victory! The photos
are remarkable!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see the prints! Now, if
you'll excuse
me...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Of course! Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Um... You really helped me out today,
Bamboo.
Please accept this token of my
th—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I don't need anything right now!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But... why?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because I want you to thank me on the
track
someday!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Right!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It sure is great having a rival!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It sure is great having a rival!
choice_data_list: A race between those two is bound to be heated.
A race between those two is going to be so exciting, isn't it?
Are you confident you can win?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If the two of us are running,
the race is
bound to be red-hot!
choice_data_list: A race between those two is bound to be heated.
A race between those two is going to be so exciting, isn't it?
Are you confident you can win?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! I've gotta train hard if I want to
win!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah! I'm so excited!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following this, Bamboo Memory throws
herself
into her training with more vigor
than ever
before.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Are you saying you think I can't
win?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! Putting it into words definitely
helps
get you motivated!
choice_data_list: I just wanted to make my intentions clear.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm definitely gonna win this
showdown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory looks incredibly serious
as she
makes this declaration.
